title: Signalbox rule parameters
description: The rules: section of signalbox.yaml (ADR 0027). Rules without parameters accept enabled, severity and scopes without params.

warn_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which a warning is reported.
warn_days.title: Warn Days

urgent_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which the warning is an error (an expired certificate is always an error).
urgent_days.title: Urgent Days

warn_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which a warning is reported.
warn_days.title: Warn Days

urgent_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which the warning is an error (an expired certificate is always an error).
urgent_days.title: Urgent Days

days.description: Report changes made in the last this many days.
days.title: Days

minutes.description: A change that follows Signalbox's own backup within this time is Signalbox's.
minutes.title: Minutes

days.description: Days without an update of the name.
days.title: Days

strip_domain.description: On: compare only the part before the first dot (nas and nas.example.lan are the same name); off: compare the full names. 1 and 0 are accepted as well.
strip_domain.title: Strip Domain

min_ports.description: A device counts as restarted when its counters restarted from zero on all its ports that report counters, and there are at least this many.
min_ports.title: Min Ports

memory_pct.description: Memory in use from which it is reported.
memory_pct.title: Memory Pct

temperature_c.description: Temperature limit for sensors that report no limit of their own.
temperature_c.title: Temperature C

min_seconds.description: Leases shorter than this are reported.
min_seconds.title: Min Seconds

max_seconds.description: Leases longer than this are reported.
max_seconds.title: Max Seconds

guest_max_seconds.description: Leases longer than this are reported on guest networks.
guest_max_seconds.title: Guest Max Seconds

high_pct.description: Share of the pool in use above which it is reported as nearly full.
high_pct.title: High Pct

days.description: Days since the block list was last downloaded.
days.title: Days

warn_pct.description: Fill level from which it is a warning.
warn_pct.title: Warn Pct

error_pct.description: Fill level from which it is an error.
error_pct.title: Error Pct

minutes.description: Remaining runtime below which it is reported.
minutes.title: Minutes

days.description: Uptime from which it is reported.
days.title: Days

tolerance_bytes.description: Frame size the neighbour may be smaller than the local MTU needs before it is reported (devices count header, tag and FCS differently).
tolerance_bytes.title: Tolerance Bytes

max_hops.description: Most wireless hops between a node and the wired network.
max_hops.title: Max Hops

signal_dbm.description: Backhaul signal below which a link is weak.
signal_dbm.title: Signal Dbm

rate_mbps.description: Backhaul link rate below which a link is slow.
rate_mbps.title: Rate Mbps

warn_pct.description: Share of the budget in use from which it is a warning (100 % is an error).
warn_pct.title: Warn Pct

margin_w.description: Watts the request may exceed the port's limit by before it is reported.
margin_w.title: Margin W

min_collisions.description: Fewer collisions than this between two reads are never reported.
min_collisions.title: Min Collisions

drop_ratio.description: Report a port when the packets dropped between two reads are at least this share of its packets (0.01: one in a hundred).
drop_ratio.title: Drop Ratio

min_packets.description: Reads with fewer packets than this on a port are too small to judge.
min_packets.title: Min Packets

min_drops.description: Fewer drops than this between two reads are never reported.
min_drops.title: Min Drops

error_ratio.description: Report a port (information) when the errors between two reads are at least this share of its packets (0.001: one in a thousand).
error_ratio.title: Error Ratio

crc_ratio.description: Warn when the CRC/FCS errors received between two reads are at least this share of the packets received (0.0001: one in ten thousand).
crc_ratio.title: Crc Ratio

min_packets.description: Reads with fewer packets than this on a port are too small to judge.
min_packets.title: Min Packets

min_errors.description: Fewer errors than this between two reads are never reported (a single bad frame).
min_errors.title: Min Errors

idle_kbps.description: A trunk that carries no more than this between two reads (in both directions together) counts as idle; spanning tree and LLDP frames alone are below a kilobit per second.
idle_kbps.title: Idle Kbps

min_seconds.description: Reads closer together than this are too short to judge.
min_seconds.title: Min Seconds

idle_hours.description: The trunk must have been idle for this many hours (every hourly bucket of the recorded series at or below idle_kbps). 0: only the last read interval. Falls back to the last interval while the series covers too little of the period.
idle_hours.title: Idle Hours

min_coverage_pct.description: The series must cover at least this share of idle_hours, else the last read interval is judged.
min_coverage_pct.title: Min Coverage Pct

utilisation_pct.description: Report a port when it carried at least this share of its link speed, in either direction, between the last two reads.
utilisation_pct.title: Utilisation Pct

min_seconds.description: Reads closer together than this are too short to judge a rate.
min_seconds.title: Min Seconds

window_hours.description: Judge the traffic of the last this many hours (hourly averages of the recorded series) instead of the last read interval. 0: only the last interval. Falls back to the last interval while the series covers too little of the window.
window_hours.title: Window Hours

percentile.description: Which hourly rate of the window is compared with utilisation_pct: 90 means the rate that 90 % of the hours stay below (100: the busiest hour).
percentile.title: Percentile

min_coverage_pct.description: The series must cover at least this share of the window, else the last read interval is judged.
min_coverage_pct.title: Min Coverage Pct

warn_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which a warning is reported.
warn_days.title: Warn Days

urgent_days.description: Days before the expiry date from which the warning is an error (an expired certificate is always an error).
urgent_days.title: Urgent Days

max_seconds.description: Clock offset allowed beyond the uncertainty of the read.
max_seconds.title: Max Seconds

minutes.description: Time without a handshake after which a peer is reported.
minutes.title: Minutes

loss_pct.description: Packet loss from which a line is degraded.
loss_pct.title: Loss Pct

latency_ms.description: Latency from which a line is degraded.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

dbm.description: Neighbours weaker than this are not counted.
dbm.title: Dbm

count.description: Neighbours from which it is reported.
count.title: Count

min_dbm.description: A client below this signal is weak (#447). The history keeps the signal in steps of 5 dB.
min_dbm.title: Min Dbm

sustained_minutes.description: How long the client has been weak on the same access point (#447).
sustained_minutes.title: Sustained Minutes

margin_db.description: How much stronger the client's signal was on another access point of the SSID before (#447).
margin_db.title: Margin Db

min_dbm.description: A client below this signal is slow and drops packets (#170). The history keeps the signal in steps of 5 dB.
min_dbm.title: Min Dbm

sustained_minutes.description: How long a client must have been weak on the same access point before it is reported (#447). Without any history the current reading counts.
sustained_minutes.title: Sustained Minutes

max_period.description: A DTIM period above this makes sleeping clients wait that many beacons for broadcast and multicast traffic (#447).
max_period.title: Max Period

max_dbm.description: A minimum signal above this kicks clients that are still usable (#168). The fix suggests 5 dBm below it.
max_dbm.title: Max Dbm

max_clients.description: A radio with more clients than this is crowded (#447).
max_clients.title: Max Clients

idle_clients.description: Another radio with the same SSID and fewer clients than this counts as free (#447).
idle_clients.title: Idle Clients

ScopeMatch.description: Which objects a scope applies to; every selector given must match (and).

segment.description: Network (segment) id, name or VLAN id.
segment.title: Segment

tag.description: A tag of the object's annotation (#186).
tag.title: Tag

ScopeMatch.title: ScopeMatch
